notes:
Big update!
- Bigger maps, plus two new ones: Farmstead and Downtown
- Play on phones and tablets (touch controls)
- 10 new guns incl. the Kar98k, new grenades and tacticals, sniper scopes
- 7 new scorestreaks, up to the Tactical Nuke
- Emotes, tracer rounds, keychains, new camos, codes, achievement rewards
- Parties, matchmaking, private matches and voice chat
- More realistic soldiers, zombies, guns and furniture
